target_customer: Product, marketing and research teams at companies that need customer research faster than their researchers can run it
problem: Teams have more decisions than research capacity, so many are made on gut feel. Overheard runs voice interviews with dozens of customers or panel members at once and returns answers with supporting quotes.
business_model: B2B SaaS for AI moderated customer research (pricing not found)
product_category: AI customer research and voice interviewing

founders.name: Tyler Lehman
founders.background_notes: YC page says he was a full-stack engineer before product roles. Education not listed.

founders.name: Arthur Chi
founders.role: Co-founder (per the OpenFoundry launch post cited on the YC page)
founders.background_notes: Built large scale APIs at Slack per YC page. Title and education not listed.

technical_complexity.rationale: Real time voice interviewing at scale, moderation quality and synthesis with quote linking are standard LLM and speech engineering with some hard parts. The original OpenFoundry idea was open source AI infrastructure, a different problem.

defensibility.rationale: Voice interview plus synthesis is copyable by funded research tools, and the pivot happened years after the batch so no data or switching cost moat is visible.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: AI interview platforms became crowded. Salesforce agreed to buy Listen Labs in a reported $2B deal in October 2026, showing incumbents are active in this wedge (this concerns the later market, not the founding date).

market_need_then: At batch time (W24) the company was building open source AI infrastructure, so the market need for customer research is a later pivot thesis. The YC page says teams have more decisions than research capacity. No dated demand evidence for the original idea was found.

branding.domain_note: Uses withoverheard.com, a prefixed domain; the earlier name used openfoundry.ai per the YC page links.

identity.logo: not described by any source found
identity.voice_and_tone: plain, outcome focused copy (Understand your customers for every decision)

rebrands.why: Company moved on from open source AI infrastructure to voice customer research, per the YC page update

brand_strength.rationale: No press, community or merch about the brand was found. The name only recently replaced OpenFoundry.

pivots.from: OpenFoundry, open source AI infrastructure and developer tooling
pivots.why: YC page says the team moved on from open source AI infrastructure; no further reason stated

outcome_analysis: Overheard is active with a team of two and has no confirmed outside funding. It entered YC W24 as OpenFoundry, an open source AI infrastructure tool, and pivoted by September 2026 into voice based customer research. The new market is crowded with funded players, so the story is still unresolved and any success rests on the pivot finding traction.
notes: Outcome search found no acquisition, shutdown or layoffs. Funding: one aggregator (VCBacked) lists $500K pre-seed for OpenFoundry in April 2024 with Y Combinator as investor; unverified and not recorded as a round, no cross-check found. The competitor search returned only 2026 roundups, so the dated competitor list is empty. Education for both founders not found. Branding search found nothing on name origin or logo.
